candidates.title: Georg Philipp Telemann - Concerto for 4 violins no. 4 - TWV 40:204
candidates.description:
Telemann wrote a series of 4 concerti for 4 violins without bass or harpsichord dated probably around 1720. While the first three in the series are relatively well known and played, the fourth is rarely played. This may be because there is still some debate about its authenticity as no original manuscript or direct copy survives.

But this is a lovely 4-movement concerto, with a selection of slow and fast movements providing liveliness and expressiveness in equal measure.

I hope you enjoy this rendition of the rarely played concerto no. 4 of Telemann's Concerto for 4 violins.
